idea-plugin.name: TellForgeAI
idea-plugin.description:
TellForgeAI is a bring-your-own-key AI coding assistant with two modes: Foretell (plan/read-only) and Forge (edit/build), powered by any OpenAI-compatible API.

Features

  • Tool-window chat with streaming responses and reasoning/thinking display
  • Multiple named provider profiles and a per-project provider/model dropdown
  • Works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, Together, and more
  • Optional second model for Foretell mode, per provider
  • Agentic tool use: the model can list, read and search project files, and run terminal commands
  • Reasoning-effort control and auto-detected context window with a usage meter
  • Automatic context compaction summarizes older turns while preserving the full chat transcript
  • Persisted chat history per project

Security

  • API keys are stored in the IDE PasswordSafe (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager or the Linux keyring) — never in plain-text settings files
  • In Foretell (plan) mode only read-only commands are permitted
  • Terminal command execution requires explicit user approval by default (toggleable); redirects, command substitution and compound commands are always refused. In read-only mode simple pipelines into pure readers (head, tail, wc, sort, uniq, cut) are allowed
